_doc: Challenge modes (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 area 'Schwierigkeit und Herausforderungen', items 486-520). They join the four rules in data/ideas200.json 'challenges' and are read by ChallengeRules. Any set of them can be taken at a new game or before the first mended Rift, and dropped at any time. None of them is sold in the shop.

modes.name: One per Place
modes.text: Only one Spirling may bond with you in each place.

modes.name: First Meeting
modes.text: Only the first wild battle in each place can end in a bond.

modes.name: Spring Water Only
modes.text: No healing items, in battle or out. Only rest springs mend your team.

modes.name: Shuffled Wilds
modes.text: The wild Spirlings of every place are shuffled by your run seed.

modes.name: Shuffled Arts
modes.text: Every Spirling that bonds with you knows arts drawn by your run seed.

modes.name: Stand Your Ground
modes.text: No swapping in battle. A Spirling only leaves the field when it falls.

modes.name: Half Rested
modes.text: Rest springs only mend half of each Spirling's Vigor.

modes.name: Ace Up Front
modes.text: Wayfarers lead with their strongest Spirling.
